rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken way to say that something is made of gold.

example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 geng2 lin2 hai6 gam1 ge3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for the metal and for gold considered as wealth or treasure.

example.english: This necklace is made of gold.
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 hong6 lin6 hai6 jung6 gam1 zou6 ge3

rows.note: Use 黃金 especially for physical or bullion gold rather than the everyday general term 金.

example.english: Is this piece of gold heavy?
example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 wong4 gam1 zung6 m4 zung6

rows.note: Use this when something only has the colour of gold rather than being made of gold.

example.english: This handbag is gold in colour.
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 sau2 doi6 hai6 gam1 sik1 ge3

rows.note: Use 金色 when gold refers specifically to the deep yellow colour.

example.english: I want to buy a sheet of gold-coloured card.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 zoeng1 gam1 sik1 ge3 kaa1 zi2

rows.note: Use 金幣 when the gold is specifically in the form of coins.

example.english: You have to save up a hundred gold coins in the game before you can exchange them for a prize.
example.traditional: 遊戲入面儲夠一百個金幣，先可以換獎品。
example.jyutping: jau4 hei3 jap6 min6 cyu5 gau3 jat1 baak3 go3 gam1 bai6 sin1 ho2 ji5 wun6 zoeng2 ban2
